title.fr: Les Territoires du Nord-Ouest et le Nunavut

text.en: The Northwest Territories were first put together in 1870, out of the North-Western Territory and Rupert's Land.
text.fr: Les Territoires du Nord-Ouest ont d'abord été formés en 1870, à partir du Territoire du Nord-Ouest et de la Terre de Rupert.

source.quote: The Northwest Territories (N.W.T.) were originally made up in 1870 from Rupert’s Land and the North-Western Territory.

verification.evidence: The Northwest Territories (N.W.T.) were originally made up in 1870 from Rupert’s Land and the North-Western Territory.

text.en: The Aboriginal peoples of the Northwest Territories today are the Dene, the Inuit and the Métis.
text.fr: Les peuples autochtones des Territoires du Nord-Ouest sont aujourd'hui les Dene, les Inuit et les Métis.

source.quote: the population is Aboriginal (Dene, Inuit and Métis)

verification.evidence: More than half the population is Aboriginal (Dene, Inuit and Métis).

text.en: Water from 1.8 million square kilometres of land flows into the Mackenzie River.
text.fr: Les eaux d'un territoire de 1,8 million de kilomètres carrés s'écoulent dans le fleuve Mackenzie.

source.quote: and drains an area of 1.8 million square kilometres.

verification.evidence: The Mackenzie River, at 4,200 kilometres, is the second-longest river system in North America after the Mississippi and drains an area of 1.8 million square kilometres.

text.en: Martin Frobisher went into the uncharted Arctic in 1576, for Queen Elizabeth I.
text.fr: Martin Frobisher s'est aventuré dans l'Arctique inexploré en 1576, pour la reine Elizabeth I.

source.quote: who penetrated the uncharted Arctic for Queen Elizabeth I in 1576

verification.evidence: The capital is Iqaluit, formerly Frobisher Bay, named after the English explorer Martin Frobisher, who penetrated the uncharted Arctic for Queen Elizabeth I in 1576.

text.en: In Nunavut, Inuktitut is one of the official languages.
text.fr: Au Nunavut, l'inuktitut est une des langues officielles.

verification.evidence: The population is about 85% Inuit, and Inuktitut is an official language and the first language in schools.

text.en: In Nunavut's schools, Inuktitut is the first language used.
text.fr: Dans les écoles du Nunavut, l'inuktitut est la première langue utilisée.

source.quote: Inuktitut is an official language and the first language in schools.

verification.evidence: The population is about 85% Inuit, and Inuktitut is an official language and the first language in schools.
